reuse.why: Adds the check to assertNotLinkedElsewhere, the existing precheck every provider link function already calls.

duplication.why: A single added check; no provider function is touched.

placement.why: The shared link precondition is the right layer, though the helper's name (assertNotLinkedElsewhere) now understates that it also rejects closed targets.

scope.why: One focused addition to the shared precheck.

maintainability.why: Small and covers all six link paths; a name that reflects both preconditions would make it easier to find.

one_place.where: server/accounts/app.ts assertNotLinkedElsewhere, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount, linkFintegraAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
